subject: 10 is 10 not 70
author: Xandu
body:
To me it sounds like 10 challenges that can be done by 2 - 8 players. It's the same challenge only with different numbers of players. But I guess we will not  know until the update is released.

It's kind of like car liveries, the PCPD has 5 liveries but it is still only one car.

If it is actually 70 different challenges that would be cool... but then the trophy description does not make sense.

It also sounds like they are not timed challenges... maybe the timed challenges for the Island will be additional paid content. 800 for 10 timed challenges sounds about right?   

-- The Creator --

subject: 70 in all, you tards.

Complete all 10 Island Freeburn Challenges
